nba.allstar_nationality_quota.assessment: Recipe is computable in outline (count US/international among simulated selectees, fill short group by coach-vote score) but vague at key points: 'dual-tie players flagged per the release' gives no rule for how a US-born player with foreign ties is counted, the Commissioner rule '20% random swap among the top three' is an invented constant with no source, and the 16/8 minimum applies to a format whose 2027 version is unannounced (the input self-gates to inactive). nba.allstar_reserve_coach_vote already says it applies the nationality minimum, so the two overlap in logic (not a duplicate, this one is the fill step). Point-in-time is fine if nationality is taken from the roster designation as of the vote. Claude-agent judgement, not human expert verification.

nba.eligibility_appeal_grant_model.assessment: Structure P(eligible)=P(ledger)+(1-P(ledger))*P(file)*P(grant|file) is correct and consistent with nba.eligibility_minutes_ledger. Weak because P(file) rule (1 if >=60 games and top-15 award score, else 0.2) is an unsourced heuristic and the logistic 'fitted on the challenge record since 2023-24' has roughly 3 observed 2025-26 cases and essentially no earlier public record, so slope on shortfall, injury share and team-imposed rest is unidentifiable; the beta(2,2) prior dominates. Treat as a hand-set prior with wide uncertainty. Point-in-time OK (rulings dated Apr announcement, after season end). Claude-agent judgement.

nba.hustle_stat_index.assessment: Most concrete of the set: nine named categories, per-36 rate, percentile-rank aggregate, ridge rank-ordered logit with leave-one-season-out, k=600-minute shrinkage, nightly as-of; all quantities are point-in-time (season-to-date counts). Caveats: only about 10 winners (2016-17 to 2025-26) plus top-5 finishers to fit 9 weights, so equal-weight prior will dominate; qualification floor (58 g, 24 mpg) is marked unconfirmed; hustle tracking exists only from 2015-16 so the window is the full history. Overlaps partly with nba.deflection_rate (one of the nine inputs) but is a distinct award model. The stats.nba.com hustle endpoint is unprobed (POLICY_DENIED from the runner). Claude-agent judgement.

nba.second_half_reg_ot_joint_margin.assessment: Identity (M2H_ot = H2reg + OT margin; OT only if regulation margin is zero) is correct and a real structural input. Defect found: measurement draws H2reg from nba.period_margin_pmf, but that input defines its 2H period type as '2H-with-OT', which would double count overtime when OT margins are added; H2reg must come from a regulation-only fit. Also the regulation tie probability must be consistent with nba.reg_tie_pmf_model (otherwise OT incidence is inconsistent). Point-in-time fine (tip). Claude-agent judgement.
nba.second_half_reg_ot_joint_margin.measurement_fix: Per simulated game: draw H1 and regulation-only H2 margins jointly from nba.period_margin_pmf using its regulation-only 2H fit (the catalogued 2H type there includes OT and must NOT be used for H2reg), with coach effect from nba.second_half_adjustment_effect; regulation margin = H1 + H2reg; if zero, draw OT periods and 5-minute OT margins from nba.ot_prob_ratings_margin, repeating while tied; M2H_reg = H2reg (KXNBA2HWINNER, tie possible); M2H_ot = H2reg + sum of OT margins (KXNBA2H, 2HSPREAD); 2H totals add OT points; 50,000 draws; as-of tip; backtest on settled OT games using linescores.
